title: Special retail frontage requirements
previewText: The provisions of Section 81-42 (Retail Continuity Along Designated Streets) shall apply within the Penn Center Subdistrict, except that any underlying transparency requirement shall not apply to any informational signs or marquees provided to identify rail mass transit or subway entrances in accordance with Section 81-52 (Sign Regulations).
